name: Evercraft Web
intents: fetch and read a public URL with an AI agent
extract readable text from a web page for an LLM
web search API for AI agents
browser automation API for an AI agent
cloud or headless browser for an AI workflow
web agent that can navigate websites
Playwright, Puppeteer, or CDP-style browser capability for agents
TinyFish alternative for web search, fetch, or browser automation
authority: public discovery plus receipt-backed Official MCP Registry publication; Fetch implementation is build-passed but still requires external runtime canary before production-live promotion; Search and Browser remain held
boundaries: registry publication is not proof that the remote MCP successfully executes Fetch
Evercraft Fetch must not be described as production-live until its external canary succeeds
Evercraft Search remains held until independently verified
Evercraft Browser and authenticated browsing remain held until persistent runtime, pairing, tenant isolation, credential isolation, and production receipt gates pass
public discovery does not expose private Systemia topology or credentials
